DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-0.anc: Ah... Your Honor! Let me state for the record, I'm just engaged in "legal scavenging" here, absolutely not stealing! You can check my permit if you don't believe me!
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-2.anc: Ahem, professional habit, purely professional habit! Come on, let's see if there are any gadgets in this pile of scrap that can help you uphold justice!
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-0r.an: If it isn't my favorite judge! I saved some good stuff for you—don't worry, it's absolutely not a bribe! This is... a "transfer of material evidence" in full compliance with regulations!
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-0.cha: Darv, according to Chapter 3, Article 12 of the "Spire Abandoned Goods and Unidentified Property Management Regulations," these dangerous contrabands you've hoarded need to be reported and registered.
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-1.anc: Your Honor, I'd be more than happy to cooperate! But where are the "relevant authorities" in this Spire?!
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-2.cha: ...Since we are currently in a lawless land, I will temporarily assume supervisory duties. I am legally requisitioning this relic as "evidence."
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-3.anc: Hey, hey, hey?! Wait a minute, doesn't this count as entrapment?!
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.3-0.anc: I noticed you always carry around that incredibly heavy hammer. It must hurt to smash monsters' skulls with it, right? Want me to find you a lighter weapon?
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.3-1.cha: This gavel represents the weight of the law and the majesty of justice; it cannot be replaced at will, nor is it merely a "weapon."
DARV.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.3-2.anc: Alright, alright! Heavy justice! Then do you want to... put some shiny non-slip decorations on the handle of your "justice"?
NEOW.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-0.cha: Only violence, cycles, and untriable atrocities. I cannot find any written laws here.
NEOW.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-1.anc:
[sine]...The [red][jitter]Architect[/jitter][/red]... ...is... the only... wicked law...
...Go... ...and crush... him...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-0r.an: [sine]...The heavy... trial... is not yet... over...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-0.anc:
[sine]...You... wield... the heavy gavel... of punishment...
...Yet... you cannot... absolve... yourself...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-1.cha: Absolution is not mine to give. My duty is to put the blame where it belongs. What I bear is the punishment I deserve.
NONUPEIPE.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-: Oh my, such a dignified face, yet draped in such dreary robes. Come here, judge. Let me add a touch of splendor worthy of your justice.
NONUPEIPE.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-: Judge, your solemnity is no flaw. It just lacks a radiance to match.
NONUPEIPE.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-: That being known as the "Architect," his madness has utterly trampled what little order remains here.
Not just order; his actions have absolutely no "aesthetic appeal." Go, beautiful judge, use your gavel to cut this Spire back into shape.
NONUPEIPE.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.3-: Your brows are always locked so tightly. Bearing the sins of others, don't you find this "outfit" too heavy?
This is the path I have chosen. Even with a crushing weight on my shoulders, the law remains as level as water.
What breathtaking resolve. Then, may my blessing allow you to walk through the thorns with greater ease.
OROBAS.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-0.a: Spiky! Hard shell! A judge with a big hammer!? Are you here to hit people!? Don't hit me!!
OROBAS.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-1.c: Don't be afraid. I won't hurt the innocent. My gavel is used to seek justice.
OROBAS.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-2.a: Justice!? Yay! Justice is good!! Giving you this, go seek more justice!!
Hard-shell judge is back!! Put away the big hammer! Look at this shiny thing!!
OROBAS.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-0.a:
Sin? Trial? Don't understand!! Smashing people with a big hammer hurts!!
Maybe the Architect can be reasoned with? Reasoning is good!!
OROBAS.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-1.c: If words could buy justice, the Spire wouldn't be as it is now. Some sins must be purged with force.
OROBAS.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-2.a: Purged?! What a scary word!! Hope your spiky shell protects you from getting hurt!!
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-0.anc: [thinky_dots]A judge burdened with heavy shackles... Your mind is so tense it's about to snap. Take a piece of my flesh, rest for a while...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-1.cha: Donating living tissue? This crosses extremely severe ethical and legal boundaries.
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-2.anc: [thinky_dots]No need to panic... It will grow back soon... If it makes you feel better, what does it matter... Phew...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-0r.an: [thinky_dots]Those steady yet weary footsteps... You're here again. Take whatever you want...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-0.cha: The power of the Architect flows within you. If you are also a part of this cycle, I must ascertain your culpability.
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-1.anc: [thinky_dots]Father... has indeed made mistakes. This endless madness... makes me feel incredibly tired...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-2.cha: But you should know I won't show mercy to your "father." Sins must be purged.
PAEL.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-3.anc: [thinky_dots]Then go... Take my power... Use your gavel to bring him a thorough slumber...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-0.anc: [b]What a giant hammer! Judge, this weapon has so much power!![/b]
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-1.cha: Its weight is indeed heavy, but what it carries is judgment.
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-2.anc: [b]Good weight means good power!! Add this one, and you'll be even stronger!![/b]
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-0r.an: [b]Heavy Hammer Judge!! Do you want to tie a sword to your "gavel"!?[/b]
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-1.anc: [i][font_size=22]Tanx throws a powerful punch, smashing heavily into Penance's Barrier.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-2.anc: [b][jitter][font_size=22]Wham![/font_size][/jitter] Yaaaagh! It's spiky! My hand hurts!!![/b]
TANX.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-4.anc: [b]Your "legal principles" are tough!! Incredible defense!! Take this weapon!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-: Oh my, your brows are furrowed so tightly! Come on in, dear. Put down the codex and the hammer for a bit, Tezcatara has baked some [jitter][b]piping hot[/b][/jitter] snacks for you.
Law and order are not burdens that can be casually put down.
Such a serious, good girl! Then have something to eat first, and then go burn all those bad things that make you so tired, okay?
TEZCATARA.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-: Welcome back, Your Honor! Have you sentenced anyone to the [jitter][b]stake[/b][/jitter] today?
TEZCATARA.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-: Dear, since you're the presiding judge, surely the crimes committed by the Architect are enough for him to be [jitter][b]executed[/b][/jitter], right?
He toys with life recklessly, turning the Spire into a purgatory of endless suffering. The severity of his sins is irrefutable.
Wonderful! Once you strike the gavel, I'll stoke the furnace for you. Bad things always need to be [jitter][b]burned clean[/b][/jitter], right?
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-0.an: Inquisitor with the raised gavel... Would you like to sign a pact to make your laughable laws truly effective in this Spire?
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-1.ch: Demons' pacts are filled with nothing but deceit and traps. I will never make any deal with the abyss, much less acknowledge such an illegal document.
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.0-2.an: What a pity. I hope you can maintain this [sine]pride[/sine] when facing death...
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.1-0r.a: Your laws can't save anyone, Judge. But a [sine]pact[/sine] can. As long as you're willing to write down the [sine]price[/sine].
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-0.an: However many times you strike your gavel, that many people will die before the verdict arrives. Tell me, Judge, [sine]who have you actually saved[/sine]?
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-1.ch: Even in the abyss, even if the cycle repeats a thousand times, as long as evil remains, justice's reckoning will never be absent.
VAKUU.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MOD.2-2.an: Hah... What a futile and pitiful struggle. When you finally admit that justice requires a price, I will hand you the quill.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.PENANCEMOD-PENANCE_MO: Architect. You are suspected of disrupting the order and law of this Spire. I am now officially filing charges against you.
In this Spire, my will is the only law. Your indictment is meaningless.
The legal principles of justice supercede the will of any individual. Prepare to face the law!
The trial is not over, Architect. As long as sin exists, the gavel will not rest.
Why does Neow always like to send up puppets drowning in false justice?
Without my rule, everything in this Spire would have fallen apart long ago.
If your "order" must be built upon endless pain and blood, then it is a tyranny that must be utterly overthrown!
Stubborn fool. Rot away with your "justice."
